_comment: Copy to ~/.config/launchd-survival-kit/config.json (install.sh does this). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every key is optional, defaults live in each script.

bootguard._comment: Only labels listed in revive are ever bootstrapped. A job you killed on purpose stays dead. Never list a job that boots itself out by design.

reaper._comment: Only Chrome launched with a user-data-dir under one of these prefixes counts as automation. Your everyday browser is never touched.

idle_session._comment: Sweeps finished AI agent session processes that never exited. Empty process_pattern disables the rule. Example targets Claude desktop session workers.

disk_reap._comment: Runs only when free disk drops under trigger_gb. Deletes only matches older than the age floor (minutes). Broad roots like ~ or /tmp are refused for dir targets.

ram_relief._notify_comment: Shell command run with the message in $LSK_MESSAGE. Swap in a curl to a Slack, Discord or ntfy webhook if you prefer.
ram_relief.notify_command: osascript -e 'display notification (system attribute "LSK_MESSAGE") with title "launchd survival kit"'
